title: Optical components on a breadboard table
visual_facts: A black rectangular optical breadboard with a regular grid of threaded holes sits on a white laboratory table.
Several optical mounts and cylindrical components are fixed to the breadboard.
A long black tube with a blue lens at its end extends in from the left.
A compact black unit with a yellow warning label is mounted near the back center.
A black electronic box with a small red digital display sits behind the breadboard at left.
Stools and table legs are visible in the background.
spatial_relations: The optical components are mounted across the breadboard surface.
The electronic box sits behind the breadboard, toward the left.
uncertainties: The exact function and specifications of the optical setup are not shown.
Small labels on the instruments are unreadable.
